The Asking Rock is located a short distance in from the trailhead, just past the Stryen Creek bridge. It is a place of great historical and spiritual significance to the Nlaka'pamux people. When they pass by, they stop and say a short prayer before

their journey. Visitors are invited to experience the peace and spirituality of the Asking Rock, and are welcome to pray according to their own faith. To avoid tarnishing the appearance of this special place. Nlaka'pemux elders ask that no offerings or
other physical items are left behind.
